resources.string: Add a network folder from your phone
This page is not encrypted. Your password crosses your home Wi-Fi once, unencrypted, to the TV. The TV keeps it encrypted.
Type the user name and password on your phone, then choose Send to TV.
Received from your phone. Signing in…
Too many failed sign-ins, so the phone page was closed. Go back and start again on the TV.
Signed in to %1$s. Choose the folder on the TV.
%1$s didn\'t accept that user name or password. Check them and send again.
Can\'t reach %1$s (%2$s). Check it\'s on and on the same network, then send again.
%1$s doesn\'t allow guests. Enter a user name and password, then send again.
Your account can\'t open this shared folder on %1$s. Choose another one, or give your account access on %1$s, then send again.
